answer.explanation: Between 03:01:43 and 03:11:43Z, CompressionFunction failed on every invocation I could see with NoSuchBucket on S3 PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET (about 25 failures at ~0.5 s each). The bucket named in the live configuration does not exist. A NoSuchBucket error is not an authorization failure, so the IAM layer is unlikely. Log lines show no AccessDenied or similar errors for any function. The other three functions (CrudApi, Uploader, Thumbnailer) log normal REPORT lines with no errors, and no alarms are active. I could not read the live Lambda configuration or the infrastructure-as-code template with the tools available, so I could not confirm whether the bad value is set in the live environment or inherited from the template. The candidate list is therefore ordered by the most likely artifact, the live OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable.
